- "associate producer for 'Dark Shadows'". Could be a role: "associate producer" (occupation) with qualifier "for" or "employer". Might use relation "employer" linking to "Dark Shadows". But we can produce multiple triplets: (George DiCenzo, field of work, film), (field of work, TV), etc. But maybe "field of work" is "film", "television", "stage", "commercial". Use separate triplets.
